_comment: YOLTON e-bike pack (Coupang 9101801616). The user confirmed 12 V and 45 Ah. Volton's 12 V 45 Ah listing (https://www.voltonbattery.com/12v/?idx=407) says lithium-ion with LG cells. cell_configuration 3S, max_voltage_v 12.6, and min_voltage_v 9.0 are assumed for 3S Li-ion; verify with a meter at full charge (3 x 4.2 V = 12.6 V, 3 x 3.0 V = 9.0 V). max_charge_current_a and max_discharge_current_a stay null: the listing does not give them, and this file has no way to store an unverified number that the loader would treat as a real limit. The service still starts. Overcurrent alarms stay off, and SHUNT_CAL uses the Matek full scale. Charge with a 12.6 V CC/CV Li-ion charger (Volton's own charger), not a plain 12 V power adapter. shunt_resistance_ohm, shunt_rated_current_a, ina228_address, and adc_range_mv are Matek I2C-INA-BM module facts (https://www.mateksys.com/?portfolio=i2c-ina-bm and TI SLYS021), not pack current. UART is optional and unused.
_cell_configuration_note: assumed for 3S Li-ion; verify with a meter at full charge
